ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District and RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 14-G in the area bound by:

West 59th Street; South Loomis Boulevard; a line 109 feet south of and parallel to West
59th Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to South Loomis Boulevard,

to those of a C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

tebhanie D. Coleman
Alderman, 16" Ward

Common Address:
5900 S. Loomis Boulevard
